notes:
OCRelay 1.1.13  (everything since 1.1.3)

PROBLEMS NOW REPORT THEMSELVES

• When a fill does not fully land, OCRelay now says so centrally, by itself. It already knew — until now that knowledge only reached a log file on your machine. The OB Limited biometry fault below sat in the logs from 14 September and was not reported by a person until the 28th.

• Nothing is asked of you and nothing interrupts you. It reports only real problems: values with no matching report line, lines that never took the paste, a fall back to the whole-report paste, or a crash. A clean fill sends nothing.

• What is sent: the app version, the study, what OCRelay read, which report lines it filled, and about two minutes of log around that run. Roughly 1 KB.

• WHAT IS NEVER SENT: the worksheet image. It is the one thing that can carry a patient's name and MRN, so it is excluded by design, not by habit. Account names, tokens and any long identifier-shaped number are stripped from the log excerpt before it leaves the machine.

• Reports are readable by the administrator only. Everyone else files them — silently and through Report a Problem — and reads nothing back. VIEW REPORTS appears in Settings for an administrator, listing what has been reported newest first, with the full detail and log for whichever one you select, and Mark triaged / Mark fixed.

• Settings now has REPORT A PROBLEM. Describe what went wrong in your own words; the last study's context is attached for you. It replaces exporting a diagnostics zip and emailing it.

• To switch automatic reporting off, set "problem_reporting": false in settings.json.

DROPPED VALUES ARE CAUGHT AS THEY HAPPEN

• On 28 September a carotid fill wrote its first six lines and silently lost every value after that — both ECA velocities, both ICA/CCA ratios and the stenosis grade never reached the report. Nothing failed: every internal step reported success and the log said all thirteen lines were filled. The fill was going faster than PS360's editor could apply it.

• Each line is now read back immediately after it is written. A line that did not land is written again, and the pace slows for the rest of the report.

• A line is only ever rewritten while it still reads exactly as it did before, so a value can never be written twice. If a paste was merely slow rather than lost, OCRelay looks a second time and leaves it alone.

• If a value still will not go in, OCRelay falls back to the full-report paste instead of reporting success. Pick lists are worth less than a missing velocity.

• A large fill takes about a second longer. That is the cost of confirming each value instead of assuming it.

• Applies to all 25 measurement studies. Thyroid and OB BPP use a separate fill path and do not have this yet.

OB LIMITED (2nd/3rd TRIMESTER) — BIOMETRY NOW FILLS

• BPD, HC, AC and FL never filled. They were read correctly and then discarded before the fill started, because the template expected a "GA:" column beside each measurement that the live report does not have. A report line has to match in full or not at all, so the whole line was skipped.

• The biometry lines now carry the measurement only, and all four fill. The gestational age beside each row is still read and shown in the review panel; the report has no slot for it, so it is not written.

• Same fault fixed on OB Complete in 1.1.2. Limited was built earlier and never rebuilt against the live report.

• Also: added the missing "FETAL MEASUREMENTS (in cm)" heading; the EFW percentile is read and written with the weight; Maximum Vertical Pocket removed, since neither the report nor the worksheet has it (BPP still does).

• AMNIOTIC FLUID INDEX is a measurement only. When the tech writes an assessment in that box instead of measuring it — "Visually normal", "WNL" — nothing is written and the line is left for you to dictate.

CAROTID — PLEASE READ

• A carotid run on 20 September read the right ICA as 120.8 when the worksheet said 66.0, and it reached the report. The cross-check that catches this — the written ICA/CCA ratio must match the measured velocities — flagged it on both sides, but Express pastes without opening the review panel, which is the only place that check ran.

• Express now runs those checks itself and opens the review panel instead of pasting when they fail.

• When a ratio does not match, the review panel shows a red banner and outlines the three values it implicates.

• The prompt checks its own arithmetic before answering, and is told to re-read the column when a side disagrees — never to adjust a value to make it fit.

EXPRESS IS NOW PER STUDY

• Express is offered per study rather than for everything, because the risk is not the same. Carotid and CT Perfusion values constrain each other, so a misread can be contradicted by the data. An OB biometry or a vein diameter has nothing to check it against.

• Covers Carotid and CT Perfusion by default. Anything else must be turned on under Settings.

• If you had Express on for LE Arterial it will now open the review panel. Use Choose Express studies… in Settings to turn it back on.

• Express also refuses to auto-paste when a value is outside its expected range, or when a value has no matching line in the open report.

PASTE VERIFICATION

• "CHECK the report" was firing on every decimal velocity. The values were in the report, but PS360 appears to store some numeric fields without their decimals, and verification counted that as a missing value.

• Values are sent exactly as written on the tech sheet. Verification now separates three outcomes: the value landed as sent, it landed but PS360 stored it without its decimals, or it never landed.

ALSO SINCE 1.1.3

• New study: CT Perfusion (CBF <30%, TMax >6s, mismatch volume).

• Manual Check for updates in Settings, which reports why a check failed instead of failing silently.
